parts.text: [Caroline]: Wow, nice pic! You both looked amazing. One special memory for me was this pride parade I went to a few weeks ago.
[Image URL: https://dynaimage.cdn.cnn.com/cnn/digital-images/org/dfc95f14-b325-431c-b977-5b6dc2d35f9c.jpg; BLIP caption: a photo of a parade with people walking down the street]
[Melanie]: Wow, looks awesome! Did you join in?
[Caroline]: Yes, I did. It was amazing! I felt so accepted and happy, just being around people who accepted and celebrated me. It's definitely a top memory.
[Image URL: http://ninalemsparty.com/cdn/shop/collections/iStock-1292280203.jpg; BLIP caption: a photo of a group of people holding up signs and smiling]
[Melanie]: Wow, what an experience! How did it make you feel?
[Caroline]: I felt so proud and grateful - the vibes were amazing and it was comforting to know I'm not alone and have a great community around me.
[Melanie]: Wow, Caroline! That's huge! How did it feel to be around so much love and acceptance?
[Caroline]: It was awesome, Melanie! Being around people who embrace and back me up is beyond words. It really inspired me.
[Melanie]: Wow, that sounds awesome! Your friends and community really have your back. What's been the best part of it?
